definitions.explanation: taking off half a workday, either morning or afternoon

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}{半休|はんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{半休|はんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}した→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I requested a half-day off to go to the hospital.

examples.japanese: {午前|ごぜん}{半休|はんきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{用事|ようじ}→用事：01520_youji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませた→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I took the morning off to take care of business at the government office.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{半|はん}→半：10460_han⟧ (half) + {休|きゅう} (rest, day off) → half day off

COMPOUNDS:
- {午前|ごぜん}{半休|はんきゅう} (morning half-day off)
- {午後|ごご}{半休|はんきゅう} (afternoon half-day off)
- {半休|はんきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take a half-day off)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{有給休暇|ゆうきゅうきゅうか}→有給休暇：06996_yuukyuukyuuka⟧ (paid leave)
- {全休|ぜんきゅう} (full day off - less common term)
- ⟦{欠勤|けっきん}→欠勤：07732_kekkin⟧ (absence from work)
- ⟦{早退|そうたい}→早退：05767_soutai⟧ (leaving work early)

WORKPLACE USAGE:
{半休|はんきゅう} is commonly used for appointments (doctors, government offices) that can't be scheduled outside work hours. Many companies count two {半休|はんきゅう} as one full day of paid leave.
